conflicts.evidence_span_a: Carrier invoices can be disputed within 30 days from the invoice date.
conflicts.evidence_span_b: Carrier invoices can be disputed within 45 days from the invoice date.
conflicts.rationale: Finance Ops Month-End Close policy defines the dispute window for financial settlement.

conflicts.evidence_span_a: A-Class SKU Cycle Count runs nightly for distribution center inventory.
conflicts.evidence_span_b: A-Class SKU Cycle Count runs weekly for distribution center inventory.
conflicts.rationale: Inventory Accuracy Standard cites accepted ADR-77 for distribution center counting.

conflicts.evidence_span_a: Proof of Delivery customer signature is optional for standard deliveries.
conflicts.evidence_span_b: Proof of Delivery customer signature is mandatory for standard deliveries.
conflicts.rationale: Fleet Safety Policy governs legal compliance for cargo delivery.

conflicts.evidence_span_a: Tier 1 systems have a 15 minute acknowledgement target for oncall engineers.
conflicts.evidence_span_b: Tier 1 systems have a 5 minute acknowledgement target for oncall engineers.
conflicts.rationale: Platform On-call Rotation Guide reflects agreed platform incident management policy.

conflicts.evidence_span_a: Customer damage claims under 250 USD are approved automatically without human review.
conflicts.evidence_span_b: Customer damage claims under 400 USD are approved automatically without human review.
conflicts.rationale: Authority Matrix reflects latest financial authorization thresholds under ADR-87.

conflicts.evidence_span_a: Reefer loads exceeding 8 degrees C for more than 30 minutes are rejected upon receiving.
conflicts.evidence_span_b: Reefer loads exceeding 8 degrees C for more than 15 minutes are rejected upon receiving.
conflicts.rationale: ADR-88 supersedes ADR-41; traversal walks SUPERSEDES backwards to accept the 15-minute standard.

conflicts.evidence_span_a: Drivers are restricted to a maximum of 11 hours of driving in a single shift.
conflicts.evidence_span_b: Drivers are restricted to a maximum of 10 hours of driving in a single shift.
conflicts.rationale: ADR-74 supersedes ADR-30; the 10-hour ceiling is the legally active safety rule.

conflicts.evidence_span_a: External routing solver calls are retried up to 3 times before fallback.
conflicts.evidence_span_b: External routing solver calls are retried up to 1 time before fallback.
conflicts.rationale: ADR-52 supersedes ADR-18; single retry prevents downstream cascading queue delays.

conflicts.evidence_span_a: Carriers arriving within a grace period of 60 minutes retain their scheduled dock appointment.
conflicts.evidence_span_b: Carriers arriving within a grace period of 30 minutes retain their scheduled dock appointment.
conflicts.rationale: ADR-68 supersedes ADR-22; tightened grace period reduces yard congestion.

conflicts.evidence_span_a: Tractors transmit GPS telematics telemetry every 15 seconds while moving.
conflicts.evidence_span_b: Tractors transmit GPS telematics telemetry every 30 seconds while moving.
conflicts.rationale: ADR-49 supersedes ADR-12; 30-second interval balances tracking fidelity and cellular data cost.

conflicts.evidence_span_a: Operational requests to Dispatch Router timeout after 10 seconds.
conflicts.evidence_span_b: Operational requests to Dispatch Router timeout after 4 seconds.
conflicts.rationale: Operational chat consensus records production change to 4s automated fallback without manual console.

conflicts.evidence_span_a: Customs Gateway submits international import declarations 24 hours before port arrival.
conflicts.evidence_span_b: Customs Gateway submits international import declarations 48 hours before port arrival.
conflicts.rationale: Brokerage team chat confirms updated declaration filing lead time to 48 hours.

conflicts.evidence_span_a: Payments Gateway retains settlement idempotency keys for 24 hours.
conflicts.evidence_span_b: Payments Gateway retains settlement idempotency keys for 72 hours.
conflicts.rationale: Urgent engineering chat hotfix extended payment key retention to 72 hours.

conflicts.evidence_span_a: Cold Chain Monitor probe calibration allows a maximum variance of 1.5 degrees C before sensor replacement.
conflicts.evidence_span_b: Cold Chain Monitor probe calibration allows a maximum variance of 0.5 degrees C before sensor replacement.
conflicts.rationale: Quality audit in chat tightened variance threshold to 0.5 degrees C.
